repos_data.description: MCP Gateway - A meta-server for minimal Claude Code tool bloat with progressive disclosure
Local-first MCP gateway. One port for every tool and every AI client: lazy discovery (~90% token savings), tool integrity + quarantine, secrets in the OS keychain.

A zero-dependency MCP and Local tool gateway: host your own tools in any language, forward and curate tools from other MCP servers, expose them leanly to cut agent token cost, gate every call through your own policy hooks before it runs, create your own MCP servers easily with zero code - and wrap any MCP server so it speaks both protocol eras! :)
MCP proxy that collapses 50+ tools into 4 meta-tools and compresses tool outputs by 60-95% (HTML, base64, huge JSON) - cut context-token costs for any MCP client, any model
Local MCP broker that exposes one compact MCP entry for MCP clients while routing to many configured upstream servers.
One place to manage & connect to all your MCP servers
A unified Model Context Protocol server implementation that aggregates multiple MCP servers into one.
acrawl — LLM-powered web crawler. Describe what you want in plain English, get structured data back. Single Rust binary, 25 providers, MCP server built-in.
Turn any OpenAPI/Swagger API into an MCP server with real OAuth2 support. Multi-spec gateway for Claude, Cursor, Codex, and other MCP clients.
Universal MCP gateway for AI agents — 1250 tools, 354 providers. One endpoint (https://apibase.pro/mcp), pay-per-call with x402 USDC on Base + MPP USDC on Tempo.
Model Context Protocol - MCP for Mifos X

repo_meta_data.description: One endpoint in front of unlimited MCP servers and REST APIs. The agent sees a fixed ~15-tool surface however many you connect, so tool-list token cost stays flat (about 89% less on a 100-tool stack) and the savings climb as you add more. Single Rust binary.
